blocks.text: The 100-unit consignment in FG-C has an unreadable original supplier label. Its origin is SUP-A or SUP-B. No exact original-lot identity is available. Keep both possible paths.
SYNTHETIC bounded scope manifest | Dataset 1 | Reviewed fixture assumptions

Universe: NORTH-01 decorative housings, six distinct current finished-stock pools. FG-A/B/D/E/F have reviewed complete ancestry. FG-C has unresolved receiving identity. No additional current finished inventory exists in this synthetic snapshot. All units are on site.

Hold all on-site documented and possible descendants. Unknown ancestry remains uncertain. Shipped stock creates shipment review. Never automatically release existing holds. Approval binds exact evidence, inventory, policy and actions.
TR-A→FG-A; TR-B→FG-B; TR-C→FG-C; TR-D→FG-D; TR-E→FG-E; TR-F→FG-F. The accompanying lineage.csv provides confirmed and possible relations. This manifest does not add inventory.

RX-101/102: SUP-A for FG-A/B. RX-103: unresolved FG-C identity. RX-104: SUP-C for FG-D. RX-105: SUP-D for FG-E. RX-106: SUP-E for FG-F. Quantities exist only at terminal stock; this is not an extra ledger.
Cosmetic coating adhesion is inconsistent on decorative housings. Contain on-site descendants pending review. Non-safety-critical demonstration.
This notice supersedes revision 1 for scope only.
The coating deviation also applies to SUP-C. SUP-A remains affected. Do not automatically release held goods.
